          • readObject
            private void readObject(ObjectInputStream in) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
            Custom deserialization method to properly reconstruct transient fields. Recreates the ScheduledExecutorService after deserialization since it's marked as transient.
            Parameters:
            in - the ObjectInputStream to read from during deserialization
            Throws:
            IOException - if an I/O error occurs during deserialization
            ClassNotFoundException - if the class cannot be found during deserialization
